N3.back: Saved became. More one free place left
N3.why: ସାଇତା ହେଲା is the short past of the S5 verb; ଜାଗା as in S6; one is spelled ଗୋଟିଏ, not a digit, as Odia writes a lone one; no final daṇḍa, like K1's capsule.

N4.why: The number pair is S29's form; ପୂରିଗଲା (filled up) is K1's word, so it reads as full, never as lost.

N5.s: ମାଗଣା %1$lld/%2$lld ପୂରିଗଲା। ଅନଲକ୍ କଲେ ଏହା ସାଇତା ହେବ
N5.back: Free 5/5 filled-up. Unlock if-do this saved will-be
N5.why: Opens like N4 and K1; conditional କଲେ (if you do) says unlocking is what saves it; ହେବ, not ହୋଇଯିବ, keeps it at 31 of 32 clusters.

N6.why: S15's button word, so every unlock button says the same thing; 8 clusters. If the capsule truncates, bare ଅନଲକ୍ is the fallback.
